title: Gulf Air opens bookings for direct Bahrain–Kuala Lumpur flights
summary: The route expands the airline’s international network and strengthens air links between Bahrain and Malaysia

The route expands the airline’s international network and strengthens air links between Bahrain and Malaysia

TradeArabia

Gulf Air, the national carrier of Bahrain, has opened bookings for its new direct service between Bahrain International Airport (BAH) and Kuala Lumpur International Airport (KUL), with flights set to begin on September 29, 2026.

The route expands the airline’s international network and strengthens air links between Bahrain and Malaysia, while providing passengers with year-round access to one of Southeast Asia’s key travel and business hubs. 

As part of the launch, Gulf Air will operate an enhanced flight schedule to Kuala Lumpur ahead of the Formula 1 Gulf Air Bahrain Grand Prix 2026 in Malaysia, adding capacity and flexibility for fans and travellers attending the event. 

Following the race period, the route will transition into a permanent service operating on a regular schedule. 

Martin Gauss, Gulf Air Chief Executive Officer, said: "As title sponsor of the FORMULA 1 GULF AIR BAHRAIN GRAND PRIX 2026 IN MALAYSIA, taking place from 2 to 4 October 2026 at Sepang International Circuit, Gulf Air is proud to connect fans and travellers to this world-class event through our new direct service to Kuala Lumpur. Adding Kuala Lumpur as a permanent destination further strengthens our network and supports year-round connectivity between Bahrain, Malaysia, and beyond."
